status: fixed before follow-up retrieval scoring; no dev tuning
headers: production_header_on; common-header v1 remains a separate frozen experiment
code_rerank_instruction: Given a developer question, retrieve the code that implements the requested behaviour
union_policy: reserve five highest BM25 chunks; fill to twenty from current fused ordering, deduplicating by chunk_id; rerank all twenty
promotion_rule: Keep opt-in unless fresh paired group-bootstrap MRR improvement over current hybrid has lower 95% bound above zero; required-completeness and test/example MRR/coverage differences have lower bounds at least zero. Independent label review and explicit warm p50/p95 latency review are required. Missing/underpowered strata mean inconclusive, not a pass.
latency: Report synchronized warm end-to-end p50/p95 per method/cohort/repo; separate cold load, first stage and pair scoring. No automatic production enablement.
budgets: Same AST corpus across policies. Record actual top10 characters/tokens. This does not resolve the v1 cross-chunker budget confound.
symbol_policy: Only explicit backtick identifiers are resolved against source-derived definitions; matching chunks precede the dense list. No gold fields are used. Diagnostic, not production routing.
